video.title: AI欧腐《短信撩错我的冰球死对头/Sexting My Pucking Nemesis》
video.desc:
Ethan Miller, the nerdiest hockey player on the high school team, is publicly humiliated by the team Captain, Hunter Kennedy after trying to ask his sister, Hayley to prom. Furious at his teammates, Ethan tries to prove them wrong by sending a sexy text to Hayley hoping to win her heart. But Ethan has no idea that her brother, and Ethan’s number one bully, Hunter, has confiscated her phone. What will happen when Hunter can’t resist texting Ethan back?
Ethan Miller 是高中冰球队里最有书呆子气的球员。当他鼓起勇气邀请队长 Hunter Kennedy 的妹妹 Hayley 参加毕业舞会时，却遭到 Hunter 和队友们的当众羞辱。
愤怒又不甘心的 Ethan 决定证明所有人都看错了他。为了赢得 Hayley 的芳心，他主动给她发去了一条性感暧昧的短信。
然而，Ethan 并不知道，Hayley 的手机已经被哥哥没收。看到那条短信的人，正是 Ethan 最大的校园霸凌者——Hunter。
可当 Hunter 忍不住冒充妹妹回复 Ethan 时，这场发错对象的暧昧聊天，又会把两个死对头带向何方？
